description: This figure comprises three side-by-side grouped bar charts illustrating the perplexity of the LLaMA1-7B model under varying quantization bits across three validation datasets, labeled (a) WikiText, (b) PTB, and (c) C4. In each subplot, the horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Quantization Bits," with discrete values sorted in ascending numerical order from left to right as 3, 4, 8, and 16. The vertical axes represent the value, labeled "Perplexity," and use a linear scale. For subplots (a) WikiText and (c) C4, the vertical axis ranges from 0 to slightly above 30, with numeric tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 5. For subplot (b) PTB, the vertical axis ranges from 0 to over 400, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 50. Each chart features grouped bars representing two methods identified by an upper-left legend: "Uniform" shown as blue bars and "Ours" shown as orange bars. Within each quantization bit group, a blue bar is positioned on the left and an orange bar on the right, and all bars feature solid black outlines. Visually, the blue Uniform bar is taller than the adjacent orange Ours bar within every group across all three charts. In chart (a) WikiText, the tallest bar is Uniform at 3 bits with an approximate value of 31, while the shortest bars are Ours at 8 and 16 bits at roughly 18.5. In chart (b) PTB, the highest value is Uniform at 3 bits at approximately 420, and the lowest is Ours at 4 bits near 175; values for 8 and 16 bits remain near 300 for Uniform and 180 for Ours. In chart (c) C4, the tallest bar is Uniform at 3 bits at approximately 29, and the shortest bars are Ours at 8 and 16 bits near 17.5, with Uniform values for 4, 8, and 16 bits measuring close to 25.
